method: SELECT-only retrieval of every historical migration's SQL statements; non-executing, conservative SQL lexical masking of comments, string literals, double-quoted identifiers and dollar-quoted bodies; statements split at top-level semicolons.
limitations: This is a triage-only heuristic, not a full PostgreSQL SQL parser. DML embedded in DO, functions, dynamic SQL, CTEs or SELECT-callable RPCs is not counted as direct top-level DML; regex may miss edge cases. No historical SQL is approved for replay. No source bodies or identifier values included.
